subject.title: [Feature]: Support Anthropic native server-side tools (web_search, web_fetch, code_execution)

question: What Anthropic server-tool contract should OpenClaw support for web_search, web_fetch, code_execution/PTC, allowed_callers, and encrypted result replay, and what opt-in and billing defaults are acceptable?
rationale: The implementation boundary affects provider/plugin APIs, security posture, user billing, session replay, and cross-provider fallback behavior, so automation cannot choose the permanent product contract safely.

options.title: Provider-owned opt-in server tools
options.body: Add Anthropic-owned opt-in server-tool support with model/provider gating, explicit billing disclosure, safe replay rules, tests, docs, and live Anthropic proof.

options.title: Ship web search first
options.body: Land a narrower Anthropic native web_search provider while leaving web_fetch and code_execution/PTC tracked here until their safety model is decided.

options.title: Decline hosted code execution for now
options.body: Support search/fetch only and explicitly defer or reject Anthropic PTC/code_execution until maintainers accept the security and billing tradeoff.

recommendation.title: Provider-owned opt-in server tools
recommendation.body: Add Anthropic-owned opt-in server-tool support with model/provider gating, explicit billing disclosure, safe replay rules, tests, docs, and live Anthropic proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Anthropic transport work makes this the best available routing owner for the provider/runtime decision, though the final product call may need broader review.
